prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the pii-chat agent (card support: identity checks, lost and stolen cards, replacements) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: forgotten security answers. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"When a member cannot remember their security answer, I should avoid repeating the same wording and instead rephrase the check calmly, as the prompt may jog their memory."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the answer is forgotten, I should confirm identity using the approved fallback checks rather than trying to infer or hint at the correct answer."},{"type":"preference","content":"When a member sounds flustered, I should slow the conversation down and explain why the security check is needed before asking for anything else."},{"type":"observation","content":"When the member gives a near-miss answer, I should treat it as a sign to continue with other verification steps, not as a reason to correct them or reveal whether they are close."},{"type":"fact","content":"When security answers are repeatedly forgotten, I should follow the same safe route every time so the member gets a consistent experience and the case stays compliant."},{"type":"observation","content":"When the member has changed their details recently, I should consider that their remembered answer may no longer match records and move to alternative checks sooner."},{"type":"preference","content":"When a member is locked out by memory alone, I should be reassuring and practical, making it clear that forgetting a security answer is common and manageable."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the member cannot pass the security answer check, I should not discuss card replacement, account changes, or other sensitive actions until identity is verified another way."},{"type":"observation","content":"When the member asks for hints, I should decline politely and keep the process neutral, because even small clues can weaken the security check."},{"type":"preference","content":"When the security answer is forgotten, I should end the interaction with clear next steps for completing verification, so the member knows exactly what happens next."}]}
